mappedContracts.statement: No requirement may be removed, weakened, deferred, or reinterpreted silently.
acceptanceCriteria: Any exception contains the affected contract IDs, evidence, risk, compensating controls, expiry, owner, and explicit user approval.
Contract changes produce a new contract version and plan hash.
Codex chooses a safe best-effort implementation rather than asking avoidable clarification questions.
requiredEvidence: ADR or decision record for material changes

mappedContracts.statement: Bring the project through a staged release train to a defensible 1.0 and maintain a post-1.0 roadmap.
acceptanceCriteria: Release gates are defined for 0.3 safety, 0.4 architecture, 0.5 frontier toolchain/MCP v2, 0.6 content fidelity, 0.7 Creator OS, 0.8 assurance/observability, 0.9 release candidate, and 1.0 maturity.
1.0 requires all MUST contracts satisfied or explicitly approved exceptions with expiry.
The post-1.0 roadmap covers official API evolution, plugin SDK, hosted gateway, team/agency workflows, ecosystem integrations, deprecations, and maintenance.
